packageRules.description: ArgoCD syncs sisyphus/workloads and sisyphus/apps automatically. A merge here deploys immediately, so open normal PRs.
The Talos machine configs need talosctl to apply them. Hold these updates on the dependency dashboard.
The ArgoCD install needs a manual helm upgrade. Hold this update on the dependency dashboard.

The linuxserver images keep tags from old version schemes, and those tags sort above the current version. A major update on a container image is therefore often a false one. Review every major on the dependency dashboard.
linuxserver/sonarr still carries 2-part tags from 2021, such as 5.14, and Sonarr is on 4.x. Reject a tag that has only 2 parts. Real Sonarr tags have 3.
linuxserver/qbittorrent still carries Ubuntu-style tags, 14.3.9 and 20.04.1. Raise this ceiling if qBittorrent ever reaches 14.
